basic_profile.bio: CuriousNewbie123 is a 27-year-old digital marketing professional based in Manila, Philippines. With a keen interest in religious debates and gaming, they often browse Reddit during late-night hours due to their work schedule. They are single and enjoy exploring new online communities. They have a strong dislike for misinformation and malicious editing of media. In their free time, they are also passionate about animal welfare, particularly dogs, and enjoy following discussions about popular TV series like Game of Thrones.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CuriousNewbie123 has a bachelor's degree in Communications and has gained substantial knowledge in digital marketing through their job. They have developed an interest in religious and cultural discussions through self-teaching and participating in various online forums.
